action.prompt:
This fires after each leaf task. After it completes, check .kiro/specs/<spec>/tasks.md: if every sub-task under the just-completed task's parent (e.g. all T3.x under T3) is now ticked [x], append ONE entry for the parent task to docs/KIRO_JOURNAL.md; otherwise do nothing. Get the date by running `date +%F` (never guess). Start the appended text with a blank line and use EXACTLY this format (date as e.g. '8 Nov'):
### <D Mon> — Spec `<spec>`: <Tn> (<short title>)
- **Spec/task:** <sub-tasks done>
- **Kiro features:** <features>
- **Kiro got right:** <…>
- **Corrected:** <…>
- **Surprise:** <…>
Max 8 lines.
